metadata.description: Connect to a Canopy server, and manage one.

plugins.name: canopy-connector
plugins.description: Connect to your Canopy server, find skills on it, and validate and benchmark the connection. The only Canopy plugin to install at user level.

plugins.name: canopy-manager
plugins.description: Set up, run and diagnose a Canopy server. Deploy it on the server; add it at user level only while setting up.
